name: Monetaria Villas
shortDescription: 35 single-storey private pool villas near Rawai Beach, in 3 and 4-bedroom layouts.
description: Monetaria Villas is a development of 35 single-storey private pool villas near Rawai Beach on Phuket's southern tip, off Soi Werachod. Two layouts are offered: a 3-bedroom Type A of about 274 sqm and a 4-bedroom Type B of about 375 sqm, on plots of roughly 320 to 520 sqm. The project includes a clubhouse, fitness center, coworking space and cafe.

nearby.place: Nai Harn and Ya Nui beaches
